about_the_game:
Important: The game is in development. Don't buy the game if you expect a full game or a lot of elements. The game will grow over time and if you want to helping out in this process, you can communicate with the dev at any time.


____________________________________________________

You can have influence on development

____________________________________________________



- The Developer is hearing your voice. Feel free to join the discord server to discuss about features and wished content
- Join the discord server here:


____________________________________________________

What is this game about?

____________________________________________________

A dark age came upon the people of Aspira. A simple miner named Bernard was cheated out of his love. He made a pact with the demon Kalis and went into a rage. He was so powerful that even Kalis became afraid of him and decided to seal him in the castle that raised her into the sky. Before Bernard was imprisoned in the castle, he divided his soul into 5 parts, which spread across the world and gave rise to powerful monsters. Almost all of humanity fell under Bernard's rage and it seemed hopeless. But a wizard named Grindun discovered that the Tree of Life is capable of resurrecting souls. So he called you to put an end to the nightmare...

____________________________________________________

What is possible?

____________________________________________________

Character customization

- There are some options for customize your character like gender, hair and hair color




Crafting

- Create tools for gathering resources
- Make equipment that protects you
- Craft many different weapons
- Make different workbenches to get new manufacturing capabilities


Economy and Agriculture

- Grow plants to survive.
- Buy animals from NPCs, breed them and sell their yields
- Cook recipes to serve you





housing

- Build your own home with a lot of possibilities to serve your needs
- Decorate your home with a variety of decorations




Build your own village

- You can build your own village where you can rescue villagers for
- Villagers will work for you
- Villagers will protect your village




Rebuild destroyed villages and places

- You can rebuild destroyed villages
- get quests from repaired objects to get important items




Play with friends

- You can Host a game to play with 4 of your friends
- You can play online on a dedicated server with up to 50 people


Raid other players or play together

- You have the possibility to raid other bases or play together


____________________________________________________

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 9600KF / Ryzen 5 1600x
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidea GT 1080
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel I7 6700k / AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidea RTX 2070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Build on what was once and defend it with your life. Survive the wild and defeat the evil, alone or with friends in a wonderful poly world.
supported_languages:
English*, German, French, Spanish - Spain, Italian, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese
